season.evidence: Stored mid-Jul to Sep. Ascent histogram: May 2, Jun 1, Jul 2, Aug 3, Sep 4, Oct 2. Web: a Mazamas page favours before July 1 to avoid loose rock and describes the NE snow gully; a 2008 May ski trip reached the ridge; Royal Basin reports confirm snow into June. Kept Jul-Sep with Jun and Oct as shoulders.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Jun 14 2022 (inside one month of the window), summited, ends 25 m from our summit pin; but no logged route or report, and the track starts mid-way up Royal Basin (not trailhead, ~5,200 ft), so it is a partial line.
Jul 2 2022: track starts at a turnaround on Mount Clark and tops out 313 m from our summit pin (beyond the 300 m rule) although within 321 m of Peakbagger's coordinate; partial.

Oct 2 2022, approach via Shelter Rock and a boulder fan, with a failed search for the route from the Adelaide pass; the report calls the top two spires class 4; not our NE gully line, and the track is a loop from camp.

notes: Only one route in the catalog on this peak, but all three tracks start in the basin and none is a round trip or trailhead-to-summit. Summit pin is 10 m from Peakbagger's coordinate so no move. The Sundial summit area has two spires about 50 ft tall; the Oct 2022 report says the right one is the climbed top. The July 2 report supports the stored statement that early July holds steep dirty snow in the summit gully.
